Bug_Title: ASE: Method invoked in assertion may produce a side effect (ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT_METHOD)
Bug_Details:
Expressions used in assertions must not produce side effects. See SEI CERT Rule EXP06
for more information.
 SEI CERT Rule EXP06
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the `showBug` method where a side effect (incrementing the value) is occurring in the assert statement, which is not desirable. This could lead to issues in production code where the assert statement is not used for validation but for side effects.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case testShowBug triggers the bug by calling the showBug method which has a side effect (incrementing the value) in the assert statement. This causes the assert statement to fail, triggering the bug.
